source_statements: NIST explicitly permits prefix use with L and identifies mL.
The NIST volume table directly gives the equivalence.
inference.exactness_scope: Numerical unit-definition equivalence. Physical measurement uncertainty, container capacity, temperature-driven material expansion and conversion to mass require their own context.
inference.source_dependence: BIPM definition text and NIST metrology guidance express the same unit convention. They provide separate publication presentations of that convention, with shared normative dependence rather than independent physical measurements.
